name: messy-red-hot-pink-tension
image_purpose: fashion lookbook and social campaign portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic high-fashion portrait with strong feminine energy and a bold hot-pink street-fashion statement.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, fair cool-toned skin, rich auburn-red long messy-chic waves, defined brows, sharp eyeliner, subtle smoky shadow, soft matte nude-pink lips, and a bold confident slightly defiant gaze. She wears a slightly oversized hot-pink top with strong shoulders and a modern assertive silhouette, plus small statement hoops or minimalist studs.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly low-angle large-scale upper-body portrait, shoulders open and chin slightly raised, clean uncluttered neutral indoor studio or modern bedroom, generous negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Directional soft light with subtle contrast and controlled shadows adding depth; slightly cool grade with vibrant pink contrast, confident rebellious modern mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-fashion realism, 3:4 vertical editorial portrait, full-frame fashion-lens look with shallow depth of field, razor-sharp facial focus, detailed skin, hair, and fabric texture, 8K-style detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic high-fashion editorial portrait of an adult fictional woman with fair cool-toned skin, rich auburn-red long messy-chic waves with volume, defined brows, sharp eyeliner, subtle smoky shadow, soft matte nude-pink lips, bold unapologetic confident attitude and slightly defiant gaze. She wears a slightly oversized hot-pink or bold-rose top with strong shoulders and an assertive modern silhouette, with small statement hoops or minimalist studs.
